entities.summary: Mary Nazzal is a barrister, social entrepreneur, and activist. She was selected as a Young Global Leader by the World Economic Forum and was recognized by Forbes as one of the “Most Powerful Arab Women” for her work at the intersection of law, hospitality, and impact-driven ventures.
